scope: M4 software implementation and executable acceptance

benchmark_environment.aggregation: median of all five runs; failed runs may not be discarded

invariants: Admission reserves all resources before driver side effects and never overcommits
Pending and residual handles retain quota and shared/template references
No batch publishes a successful prefix when another member fails
Failed compensation enters isolation and preserves actual residual identities
Async completion identity is checked independently of completion order
A timed out operation is not assumed absent or safe to destroy before completion
Aged notifications delete only the exact installed rule generation
Unsupported PMD and old DPDK APIs are explicitly rejected
All existing functional tests pass without skips or sanitizer errors
out_of_scope_evidence: ASIC rule installation throughput and capacity
Physical packet offload and CPU bypass
